title: BACS Direct Debit indemnity claim status change.
description: Bankers' Automated Clearing System (BACS) Direct Debit Indemnity Claim (DDIC) event data. A DDIC reclaims money incorrectly debited from a payer under the Direct Debit Guarantee. This event is emitted when a claim is created and on every subsequent status transition (`PROCESSING`, `CONFIRMED`, `FAILED`).

id.title: ID
id.description: Pismo claim ID. Use this ID to fetch or reference the claim in Pismo BACS claim APIs. To cross-reference the claim at the provider, use `claim_id`.

claim_id.title: Claim ID
claim_id.description: Provider (Form3) claim ID. You can use this to link the claim in our system to the provider's claim. Absent until the claim is submitted to the scheme.

org_id.title: Org ID
org_id.description: Organization ID that owns the claim

status.title: Status
status.description: Claim status. `CREATED` (persisted, awaiting submission), `PROCESSING` (submitted to the scheme via Form3), `CONFIRMED` (delivery confirmed, terminal), `FAILED` (rejected or failed validation/submission, terminal).

reason_code.title: Reason code
reason_code.description: Bacs DDIC reason code identifying why the indemnity claim was raised, as defined by the Bacs DDIC scheme rules. `1` - amount/date differs from advance notice; `2` - no advance notice received; `3` - DDI disputed / no valid mandate; `4` - payer cancelled the DDI with the service user; `5` - account holder deceased; `6` - payer cancelled the DDI with their bank; `7` - claim raised at the service user's request; `8` - service user name disputed.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Free-text reason associated with the claim status, typically populated when a claim is `FAILED`.
